note: USFS Chattahoochee NF, Conasauga RD; Georgia's highest lake (3,150 ft) in the Cohuttas. Two loops a short way apart off one entrance: the Lower Loop within view of the lake, the Upper Loop in forest above it. Access is 15+ mi of steep, narrow, winding, rough gravel mountain road from either Chatsworth or Ellijay; Forest Road 68 is the recommended route for trailers. Swimming dock and picnic shelter across the lake; electric boat motors only. --Claude
summary: FS page + rec.gov catalog: fees 8-15 -> 15/15 (the $8 rate is the Overflow management sites'); count 30 -> 29; max_rig_ft 24 -> 25 (trailers; RVs only to 21 ft); added season mid-April to Oct 31 (2026 opened only 10/22-11/1), 14-night max, check-in times, senior/access 50%. Confirmed no electric/showers/dump, flush toilets, hydrants, rec.gov booking. Two loops ~150 m apart off one entrance - one place. Pin within ~70 m of the sites' centre.
flags: CRITERIA (rig fit): every Lake Conasauga site that permits an RV caps it at 21 ft on recreation.gov (20 of 29 sites: 'RV 21', 'Trailer 25'); EKKO books as a 23-ft motorhome. The FS page says 'RV maximum length 24 feet' and rec.gov 'Tents, pop-up campers, and travel trailers under 25 feet are recommended for this campground due to access and campsite size limitations' - so the agency's own figures disagree (24 ft vs 21 ft for RVs). No review checked for a 23-ft+ motorhome that fit.

Road closure (route, not the campground): Old CCC Camp Road / FS 18 - the Chatsworth approach in the FS directions - has its first unpaved half-mile 'closed to through traffic beginning September 8' for paving 'through November' (alert start 2026-07-14). The Ellijay approach (Gates Chapel Rd / FSR 90 / FSR 68) is not affected.

Season: in 2026 the campground did not open until 10/22 (FS current conditions: 'will open on 10/22/2026 and remain open through the night of 11/1/2026 ... drinking water will not be provided'); the published season is 'Mid-April (possibly later due to water leaks) - October 31'.
